identificationModule.briefTitle: Romiplostim N01 in Chemoradiotherapy-induced Aplastic Anemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: Romiplostim N01 in the Treatment of Refractory Chemoradiotherapy-induced Aplastic Anemia: a Single-center, Prospective, Open-label Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aimed to explore the efficacy and safety of romiplostim N01 in the treatment of chemoradiotherapy-induced aplastic anemia (AA)

interventions.name: Romiplostim N01
interventions.description: Romiplostim N01 20 µg/kg subcutaneously once a week for at least 3 months
